labels.reason: Body cells report maternal and fetal plasma meropenem concentrations and a fetal/maternal ratio as group means with SE. Notes identify pregnant cynomolgus monkeys, repeat-dose history, subsequent single dosing and sampling timing. The text and table-title doses conflict. These are candidate summary inputs; individual records, a concentration-time curve and modeling adequacy are not established.

evidence.quote: Maternal and fetal plasma meropenem in pregnant monkeys
S03 | DOI 10.11250/chemotherapy1953.40.Supplement1_145 | Table 9

Pregnant cynomolgus monkeys (n = 4): text says 360 mg/kg/day IV for 30 days (gestation days 20-50) then a single 360 mg/kg IV around gestation day 100, sampled 7-10 min after the last dose; the table title says 300 mg/kg. Kept as printed.
Each value mean ± SE of 4 monkeys. Pregnancy subgroup; not comparable with the non-pregnant PK above.

findings.reason: MI003, Monkey source animal counts and doses, remains CONFLICT with resolution_status OPEN and needed_at prepare; origin is main:/missing_information/items/2. Animal-count interpretation and dose-linked use of Monkey records remain unresolved. F0003:S6:T4:A44 reports 360 mg/kg/day IV for 30 days followed by a single 360 mg/kg IV, but attributes 300 mg/kg to the table title. A44 states n = 4 and A45 states 4 monkeys; this page does not reproduce conflicting animal-count alternatives elsewhere. These local counts do not close the inherited item.
findings.needed_material: During authorized preparation, locate exact study contexts and unresolved animal-count and dose alternatives. Retain the printed alternatives, confirm text-only stated values separately, and obtain the applicable review outcome without silently reconciling them. Dependent dose-linked acceptance remains pending.

findings.reason: Maternal and fetal plasma, pregnancy, repeat-dose history and meropenem identity are supported. Total versus unbound concentration, unchanged-drug versus other analytical basis, dose formulation basis and IV bolus versus infusion are NOT_FOUND. IV alone cannot establish either available intravenous route category.
findings.needed_material: Authorized assay and administration definitions before any dependent combination, conversion or physiological bridge; preserve maternal and fetal measurements and the pregnancy subgroup separately.

findings.reason: Source-backed candidate inputs comprise group plasma concentrations and a ratio at a stated 7-10 min sampling window. Exact sampling times, individual identifiers, body weights, IV input duration, within-day repeat-dose schedule and dose count are NOT_FOUND. This page supplies no concentration-time series or holdout design. The reported daily dose does not establish administration frequency.
findings.needed_material: For any proposed concentration-time modeling use, obtain study-linked timing and input history and assess available time-course coverage in the downstream module. Retain these summary measurements without inventing individual trajectories or a dosing schedule.

findings.reason: A45 explicitly reports mean ± SE of 4 monkeys. Arithmetic versus geometric mean, serial versus destructive sampling, censoring limits, missingness and any detection-limit substitution are NOT_FOUND. The fetal/maternal ratio's aggregation procedure is also unstated.
findings.needed_material: Obtain relevant summary, sampling and assay definitions if these inputs are considered for modeling; otherwise retain the missing definitions as explicit limitations. Do not infer animal variability from the group summaries.
